title: Clarify the pending status
source: Recorded live Codex author and reviewer
request:
People read "Pending" and ask whether they need to enter the training report again.
Please make the pending status say the report is saved on this device and waiting
to sync. Show the number waiting. The same change should appear in English and
German. Leave the sent status and the upload behaviour as they are.

after.en: Saved on this device, waiting to sync ({count})
after.de: Auf diesem Gerät gespeichert, wartet auf Synchronisierung ({count})

title: Change when reports count as sent
request: When the training report has been saved on the device, immediately count it as sent, even before the server confirms upload.
reason: Counting a locally saved report as sent changes the sync state. An engineer must review the upload and confirmation behaviour.
